architecture.mechanism: Bit-Flip Vulnerability of Shared KV-Cache Blocks in LLM Serving Systems
architecture.intervention: Implement bit-flip detection and correction mechanisms for shared KV-cache blocks during mixed-length request processing
architecture.expected_effect: Prevent silent data corruption in KV-cache blocks that cause live-token evictions and re-computation, maintaining p99 first-token latency below 800ms during traffic peaks
architecture.falsification_test: Introduce controlled bit-flips in shared KV-cache blocks during bursty mixed-length request processing and measure if the system maintains latency budgets without evictions
